name: Flap.sh

contracts.label: Portal v5.23.1 (create, curve buy/sell; emits TokenCreated)
VaultPortal (vault launches; tx.to for those, TokenCreated still comes from the Portal)
UniswapV2-style factory that creates the token's curve pair at launch
PancakeSwap V2 factory (WBNB pair created in the launch tx)

launch.name: TokenCreated
launch.signature: TokenCreated(uint256 timestamp, address creator, uint256 tokenId, address token, string name, string symbol, string metadata)
launch.notes: No indexed params. Parameter names are inferred from the data layout (word 0 = block time, 1 = creator, 2 = sequential id, 3 = token). One tx creates the token (CREATE2 vanity: *8888 standard, *7777 tax), its curve pair and the PancakeSwap V2 WBNB pair, and emits TokenCurveSetV2 / TokenDexSupplyThreshSet / TokenQuoteSet / FlapTokenTaxSet. Buys emit TokenBought(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) 0xa800a203.

graduation.threshold: ~16 BNB raised (sources differ: standard tokens are reported to migrate to PancakeSwap V3, tax tokens to V2)

notes: Multi-chain launchpad (BNB since 2024; also Robinhood Chain, Base, X Layer, Monad with their own Portals). Found by this repo's detector 20 minutes after it started on BSC: ~66 launches per 11 minutes on 2026-10-23 (more than four.meme). Vault launches go through VaultPortal, so both addresses are entrypoints.
